feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 2 (10 cm span, y 0.04 m, 12 cm track) is the best result so far at 124.6. It cut oval line losses to 0.05 per run, but slalom stayed at 1.0 and s-bend at 0.9, with max_error about 0.061 to 0.064 m. Iteration 3 (wheel_track 0.10 m) removed oval losses but cut oval progress from 0.51 to 0.14, so the narrower track is rejected. Iteration 4 (sensors forward to y 0.06 m) cut oval progress to 0.20 and left slalom losses at 1.0, so forward sensing is rejected. This candidate widens only the outer sensors to ±0.06 m. If slalom and s-bend losses fall below 0.9 per run with oscillation at or below 0.3, keep ±0.06 m and test gains or base_speed for progress. If losses stay at 0.9 to 1.0 with oscillation at or below 0.3, the tape is still leaving the footprint on the tightest bend, so test sensor_size 0.016 m at ±0.06 m next. If oscillation rises above 0.3 (iteration 2 was 0.23 to 0.27), the wider span is over-smoothing or overshooting, so revert to ±0.05 m and test footprint size before widening further.
requested_changes: If slalom and s-bend line_loss_events stay at 0.9 to 1.0 per run with max_error at or above 0.06 m and steering_oscillation at or below 0.3, change sensor_size from 0.012 m to 0.016 m at ±0.06 m. Iteration 2 showed the tape still leaving the footprint on tight bends, and larger footprints overlap more to smooth the crossing.

If steering_oscillation rises above 0.3 (iteration 2 was 0.23 to 0.27 at ±0.05 m), revert the outer sensors to ±0.05 m and inner sensors to ±0.025 m, then test sensor_size 0.016 m at that span. Iteration 1 and 2 showed the 10 cm span removes most oval losses without other changes.

Keep y 0.04 m and wheel_track 0.12 m. Iteration 3 (wheel_track 0.10 m) cut oval progress from 0.51 to 0.14, and iteration 4 (y 0.06 m) cut oval progress to 0.20, so neither change should be retried unless slalom losses fall and progress holds.
